text_panels: We built a robust Houdini to WebGL pipeline that compresses complex 3D tree, branch, and node structures into a custom web format, reducing the download size to just 3.5 MB while leveraging WebGL instancing for fast delivery.

text_panels: All dot positions are procedrually generated and animated in real-time. We used the index breakpoints to reduce the data needed to store the country data and the dot positions. This allowed us to store the data in a single image file, which is then decoded and rendered on the fly.
